displayName.ja: 【雷撃の対魔忍】 水城　ゆきかぜ

profile.ja: 新世代の戦力と期待される若き対魔忍。代々、“雷遁の術”使いを輩出する名門で彼女も亡き父親同様、“雷遁の術”を使う。“雷遁の術”とは雷を操る強力な術で攻撃系忍法では最強の火力と言われているもの。その中でも彼女の操る雷撃は強力すぎて制御が難しいため、術を行使する触媒として特別に制作された銃を使用している。ゆきかぜはその銃に雷撃の弾丸を生み出し、強力な雷撃弾を発射する事ができる。二丁拳銃を得物に、舞うように雷撃弾を放つその姿から“雷撃の対魔忍”の異名を持つ。勝気で負けず嫌い、プライドの高さが玉にキズで唯一心許せる存在が幼馴染の秋山達郎。彼となかなか恋愛関係に進展できないのが悩み。とにかく体を動かして遊ぶのが好きで年中日焼けしている美少女。
profile.en: Mizuki Yukikaze is a young Taimanin hailed as the next-generation fighting force. She comes from a prestigious line that has produced "Thunder-style ninjutsu" users for generations, and like her late father, she also wields thunder-style ninjutsu. This powerful art manipulates lightning and is said to have the strongest firepower among offensive ninjutsu. Because her lightning strikes are so intense they're hard to control, she employs a specially crafted gun as a catalyst. Yukikaze generates lightning-charged bullets in the gun and can fire devastating lightning projectiles. Armed with twin pistols, she dances across the battlefield firing lightning rounds, earning her the nickname "Thunder-strike Taimanin." She's headstrong, hates losing, and her pride is only softened by her childhood friend Akiyama Tatsuro, the one person she can truly trust. She worries that she can't advance their relationship. A perpetual sun-kissed beauty, she loves to stay active and play outdoors all year round.

text.ja: 「私になにか用？　……ふぅん？　ま、特別に付き合ってあげてもいいわよ？」
text.en: You need something from me? …Hmm? Fine, I might hang out with you specially.

text.ja: あ～暇だなぁ～。ねぇねぇ、どっか遊びに行かない？
text.en: Ah— I'm bored… Hey, hey, wanna go somewhere to have fun?

text.ja: ほらほら、行こ？　どこって、外に出るの！　行き先なんか、どうでもいいじゃない
text.en: Come on, come on, let's go! Where? Just go outside! The destination doesn't matter, does it?

text.ja: 勝負しない？　負けたらジュースおごりねっ！　ま、絶対負けないけど
text.en: Wanna make a bet? If I lose, you buy me a juice! …I won't lose, though.

text.ja: ねー、遊ぼうよぉ。任務まで、まだまだたっぷり時間あるでしょ？
text.en: Hey, let's play! We still have plenty of time before the mission, right?

text.ja: もう、どうしてさっきから知らんぷりするの？　もっと構いなさいよっ
text.en: Geez, why have you been ignoring me since earlier? Pay attention to me!

text.ja: ちょっと、さっきからなにチラチラ見てるの？　もう、いやらしいんだからっ……
text.en: Hey, what've you been glancing at since a while ago? It's so lewd…

text.ja: うぅ～。あんまり見てると、私の雷撃をお見舞いしてやるんだからっ！　覚悟しなさいよね！
text.en: Ugh— If you keep staring, I'll give you a taste of my lightning strike! Be ready!
